hold.name: Hold temperature
hold.description: Hold rooms at a fixed temperature, or raise them by an offset, for a while. Give either a temperature or an offset.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names. Leave empty for every room.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Raise (+) or lower (-) the planned target.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: Raise rooms by the boost offset for a while (defaults come from the settings).

cancel_hold.name: Cancel hold
cancel_hold.description: End a hold or boost early.

set_away.name: Set away
set_away.description: Switch heating to the away behavior until a date or for a number of days. 0 days ends it.

until.name: Until
until.description: Heating resumes on this date at the configured time.
